headline_validated_lesson: source-grounded refutation gates generated more value than additional harness construction (DIRECT_EVIDENCE: 4 rejected without a harness, 0 fabricated confirms, 1 converter preserved)
preserved_conclusion_sentence: The correction-layer selector may improve precision within the distributor/parity family, but current evidence is insufficient to justify promotion beyond an experimental, family-scoped booster.
sample_size_caveat: n=5 campaign candidates + 2 cross-references (B5 confirm, H2 refute); all rates are point estimates, NOT operating points; correction-layer predictor was derived in-sample (overfit risk)

correction_layer_selector_decision.required_validation: blind campaign validation + runtime-confirmed validation + submission-outcome validation
correction_layer_selector_decision.scope: family-scoped booster (distributor/parity/escrow/reward) — NOT a global gate
correction_layer_selector_decision.promote_if: ≥10-15 blind candidates with real lift over control + ≥1 submission-outcome confirm + no recall collapse on mixed-bug-class control
correction_layer_selector_decision.abandon_if: correction-layer-present consistently refutes, OR correction-layer-absent converts, OR measured recall drop on non-parity classes

control_comparison_on_h5_h9.in_set_recall: 1/1 (but set has no non-parity bug classes — global recall risk UNMEASURED)
